verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are documented on the seller side. The v2 Product Catalog Import API takes CSV feeds where each row is a product or variant, up to 4 GB, with replace-mode deletion semantics, per-row error CSVs and import-status webhooks. Sellers can also bulk-fulfill orders via the List CheckoutSessions endpoint. The agent-side wallet flow is per-purchase, with each spend request individually approved by the customer. Missing for 10: bulk or multi-item purchasing on the agent/buyer side, a dedicated batch-write API for fulfillment (beyond listing sessions), independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
